id.description: The id of the Candidate, exactly as given.

is_hackathon.description: True when participants build software, models, data products or hardware during the event.

eligible.description: False only when a stated restriction excludes this person, given their Eligibility facts.

eligibility_restriction.description: Who may take part, as the organiser states it; null when no restriction is stated.

travel_funded.description: Whether the organiser covers travel or lodging: none, part of it, or all of it.

travel_detail.description: What is covered and for whom; null when travel_funded is none.

reason.description: One or two sentences explaining the judgement.
